title: Software Engineer
atsTips: List languages and frameworks in a dedicated Skills section.
Mirror exact tool names from the job description, e.g. 'PostgreSQL', not 'databases'.
commonMistakes: Using a two-column resume layout that breaks parsing.
sampleBullets: Reduced API latency by 38% by refactoring database queries and adding Redis caching.

faqs.q: What keywords should a Software Engineer resume include?
faqs.a: Include languages, frameworks, cloud platforms and methodologies such as Agile and CI/CD.
